guard: cotal completion reports each shell's stub as current, differs or missing and the rc file that loads it, prints the stub with completion script <shell>, refuses the replaced completion <shell> form with nothing on stdout, refuses --json on a subcommand, and keeps the replaced forms out of help and completion
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/completion-status.smoke.ts
why: A startup line sources whatever `cotal completion <shell>` prints, so the suite drives the built binary: each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The refusal mutation restores the old behavior of printing the stub for a shell name, which a hand-wired startup line would keep sourcing without ever seeing the replacement.

mutations.name: an edited stub reads as current
mutations.expectRed: an edited stub differs from this version
mutations.cell: an edited stub differs from this version

mutations.name: a stub reads as wired in whatever the rc file says
mutations.find: wiredIn: rc && holdsSourceLine(rc, paths.stub, shell) ? paths.rc : null, ownership, legacyWiring };
mutations.replace: wiredIn: rc !== null && content !== undefined ? paths.rc : null, ownership, legacyWiring };
mutations.expectRed: a stub whose rc lost the install line is wired in nowhere
mutations.cell: a stub whose rc lost the install line is wired in nowhere

mutations.name: completion <shell> still prints the stub
mutations.find: if (Object.hasOwn(SCRIPTS, sub)) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "USAGE_INVALID", `cotal completion ${sub} is now cotal completion script ${sub}`
mutations.replace:
if (Object.hasOwn(SCRIPTS, sub)) { process.stdout.write(SCRIPTS[sub]!); process.exit(0); }
  if (false) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "USAGE_INVALID", `cotal completion ${sub} is now cotal completion script ${sub}`
mutations.expectRed: completion bash exits 1 and writes nothing on stdout
mutations.cell: completion bash exits 1 and writes nothing on stdout

mutations.name: the replaced shell forms are listed
mutations.find: summary: `replaced by completion script ${name}`, hidden: true })),
mutations.replace: summary: `replaced by completion script ${name}`, hidden: false })),
mutations.expectRed: help does not list the replaced shell forms
mutations.cell: help does not list the replaced shell forms

mutations.name: a commented-out install line counts
mutations.find: rc.split("\n").some((line) => line.replace(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/g, "") === sourceLine(stub, shell) || shell !== "powershell" && line.replace(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/g, "") === `source "${stub}"`)
mutations.expectRed: a commented-out install line wires nothing in
mutations.cell: a commented-out install line wires nothing in

mutations.name: a file it cannot read stops the status
mutations.find: return (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT" ? undefined : (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException);
mutations.replace:
if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined;
    throw e;
mutations.expectRed: a stub it cannot read makes the status partial, exit 4
mutations.cell: a stub it cannot read makes the status partial, exit 4

mutations.name: a usage refusal prints the help on stdout
mutations.expectRed: completion tcsh exits 1, writes nothing on stdout, and puts the help on stderr
mutations.cell: completion tcsh exits 1, writes nothing on stdout, and puts the help on stderr

mutations.name: a relative XDG_CONFIG_HOME is used
mutations.find: const config = xdg && isAbsolute(xdg) ? xdg : join(homedir(), ".config");

mutations.name: install writes the stub before it checks the rc's directory
mutations.find:
try { lstatSync(dirname(paths.rc)); }
    catch { throw new CommandFailure("refused", "TARGET_NOT_FOUND"
mutations.replace:
try { lstatSync(dirname(paths.rc)); }
    catch { if (false) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "TARGET_NOT_FOUND"
mutations.expectRed: install refuses a ZDOTDIR that does not exist, exit 2, with nothing written
mutations.cell: install refuses a ZDOTDIR that does not exist, exit 2, with nothing written

mutations.name: a CRLF install line counts as wired in
mutations.expectRed: an install line that ends in a carriage return wires nothing in
mutations.cell: an install line that ends in a carriage return wires nothing in

mutations.name: the status reports a relative ZDOTDIR as a relative path
mutations.expectRed: the status reads a relative ZDOTDIR from its working directory and names the absolute file
mutations.cell: the status reads a relative ZDOTDIR from its working directory and names the absolute file
